sections.heading: 1. Ten slow reps each
lines: ① Rest hands in warm water a few minutes.
② Make a loose fist, then spread fingers wide.
③ Touch your thumb to each fingertip.
④ Squeeze a soft ball x10, 2–3 times a day.

pause and see your GP or physio.

caption:
Hands too stiff to wrap the presents this Christmas Eve? 🎁

Osteoarthritis in the hands is really common, especially in the finger joints and the base of the thumb. Morning stiffness and aching after use are typical, and it varies a lot between people. Regular movement and strength work often help.

Hybi's routine: warm your hands in water for a few minutes, make a loose fist then spread your fingers, and touch your thumb to each fingertip, 10 slow reps each. Squeezing a soft ball builds grip for jars, keys and shopping bags.

A joint that's suddenly hot, red and swollen is worth getting checked. Our Sydney CBD and Chatswood physios can build your plan. Book online via the link in bio.
